arguments.command:
python -c "
import toolz

# R1 tests
assert toolz.identity(5) == 5
assert toolz.apply(lambda x: x+1, 5) == 6
assert list(toolz.thread_first(5, lambda x: x+1, lambda x: x*2)) == [12]
print('R1 passed')

# R2 tests
f = toolz.compose_left(lambda x: x+1, lambda x: x*2)
assert f(5) == 12  # (5+1)*2 = 12
g = toolz.compose(lambda x: x+1, lambda x: x*2)
assert g(5) == 11  # 5+2 = 7... wait let me check
print('compose result:', g(5))
h = toolz.pipe(5, lambda x: x+1, lambda x: x*2)
print('pipe result:', h(5))
print('R2 passed')

# R3 tests
import io
import sys
old_stderr = sys.stderr
sys.stderr = io.StringIO()
result = toolz.peek(5, lambda x: print(x, file=sys.stderr))
sys.stderr = old_stderr
print('peek result:', result)
"
